name: story-fanout
title: Fanout story
description: Dot animation of one question fanning out into three parallel searches.
usage: Query fanout on a search product card (the Search page shows it first under its capabilities). Plays only on screen; shows its resting picture with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page
notes: A question is typed into the field, a stem drops from it and branches into three search fields, each with its own query, and their ranked result rows sweep in together. The labels name the option (`queryFanout: true`) and the outcome (3 searches in parallel).

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
